title: Shared definitions (v1)
description: Shared building blocks for the v1 pii-evidence schemas. Nothing here names a scanner, detector, support state, threshold or score.

id.description: Stable semantic id: lowercase, URL-safe, slash-separated segments of [a-z0-9] words joined by hyphens. Content rules (no issue/PR numbers, release names, scanner names, scores, migration coordinates) are enforced by scripts/id-rules.mjs.

version.description: Free-form non-empty version label (tool or contract version).

domain.description: Privacy domain axis. Not mutually exclusive.

evidenceClass.description: ARCHITECTURE.md section 8. Scanner consensus is never ground truth.

valueOrigin.description: ARCHITECTURE.md section 9. Where the PII/PHI-shaped values come from.

byteSpan.description: Half-open UTF-8 byte range [start, end) into the input bytes. Must lie on character boundaries (checked by the validator).

generator.description: Identity of the tool that produced a derived artifact.

population.description: Evidence population. This repository is public only; protected evidence is never stored or projected here.

externalRef.description: A pinned reference to evidence owned by another repository (for example PERSON evidence in ner-evidence). Identity only: repository, pinned immutable snapshot id and entity id. No names, text, spans or other content may be copied; additionalProperties is false, so an inline content field is a schema error.

repository.description: owner/name of the owning repository. The enum grows additively when a new owner is justified.

snapshot.description: Pinned immutable snapshot identity in that repository. Floating names such as latest or main are rejected by the validator.

entity.description: Entity id chosen by the owning repository.

review.description: Review state with links to ReviewEvent records. 'reviewed' needs at least one event; an agent never marks its own work reviewed.
